description: Heavy rainfall causes severe waterlogging on boundary road between Ward 12 and Ward 13. Stormwater drain clogged, road flooded 2 feet deep preventing transit.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Waterlogging on road is hydraulically caused by drainage blockage. Dewatering and drain clearance is prerequisite before road damage inspection or asphalt resurfacing.

description: Boundary canal overflowing on GN Chetty Road between Ward 12 and Ward 13, water submerging road pavement and eroding asphalt edges.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Canal overflow must be arrested by Drainage department dewatering units before Roads department can execute sub-base stabilization.

description: Heavy thunderstorm uprooted roadside tree branch that fell directly onto high-tension 11kV power line, wire is sparking violently against tree foliage on boundary road.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Live electrical danger presents imminent electrocution hazard. Electricity department must de-energize and secure cable before Horticulture crews can safely saw tree limbs.

description: Snapped street light electric cable touching wet iron road railing and tree leaves after heavy rain, electric current leaking.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Power distribution crew must immediately isolate feeder circuit to prevent public shock before tree pruning and railing repair.

description: High pressure drinking water underground pipeline burst under main arterial road, gushing water washed away road sub-base creating dangerous asphalt sinkhole crater.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Pipeline burst is the active cause of ground subsidence. Water board must isolate valve and repair pipe before Roads crew can backfill and pave sinkhole.

description: Floodwater from clogged drain submerged street electricity junction box, visible electric sparks and boiling water creating high fatality electrocution trap.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Immediate power shutdown at substation is required within minutes to prevent deaths. Drainage crew can only pump water after electricity department clears grid safety.

description: Massive gulmohar tree uprooted across four-lane boundary arterial avenue, crushed road median divider and damaged asphalt surface.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Tree trunk must be sectioned and evacuated by Horticulture woodcutters before Roads Department can access and rebuild damaged central divider kerb.

description: Huge heap of commercial market refuse and packaging dumped inside open stormwater drain canal entrance, causing localized road flooding.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Solid Waste department compactors and excavators must haul external dumped garbage before Drainage crew can desilt interior canal bed.

description: Large deep asphalt pothole in middle of residential road causing two-wheeler skidding. No waterlogging or wires.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Standard road infrastructure pothole maintenance within interior ward.

description: Four streetlights dark on residential 2nd street, timer switch malfunctioning.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Streetlight luminaire replacement and photocell timer maintenance under Electricity department.

description: Storm drain chamber silted up in public park interior, water overflow on grass lawn.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Silt removal and chamber cleaning within single ward.

description: Dry tree branch snapped inside playground compound, lying on ground.

ground_truth.conflict_resolution_rationale: Garden and tree debris clearance by local horticulture team.
